newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech govt finalises Aero jet fighter purchase.
newsitem.headline: Czech govt finalises Aero jet fighter purchase.

text.p: The Czech government on Thursday gave final approval to the purchase of 72 L-159 light jet fighters from the Czech aircraft maker Aero Vodochody a.s., Defence Minister Miloslav Vyborny said.

"I'm happy to announce that the government, a few moments ago, approved the contract between Aero and the ministry of defence on the purchase of 72 L-159 aircraft," Vyborny told journalists at an unveiling of the upgraded jet while a cabinet session continued in Prague.
Financial details were not immediately available.
Cash-strapped Aero is pinning hopes of recovering from financial problems on its flagship L- 159, a light training subsonic fighter upgraded with Rockwell International Corp avionics.
The Czech army has signed up to buy 72 L-159s, and officials say other countries have shown interest in the plane including neighbouring Hungary.

In May, the cabinet agreed to begin exclusive talks on selling a 34-40 percent stake in Aero Vodochody to a consortium of Boeing Co, McDonnell Douglas Corp. and the Czech national airline Ceske Aerolinie a.s. (CSA) as part of a broader restructuring programme.
The government last year approved a 3.26 billion crown package clearing the heavily indebted company's books.
